title: Zork I
subtitle: The Great Underground Empire
blurb: Beneath a white house lies a ruined empire full of treasure, a troll, a thief and a lot of darkness. Where it all began.

title: Zork II
subtitle: The Wizard of Frobozz
blurb: Deeper in the Empire, an eccentric wizard does his best to make your treasure hunt harder.

title: Zork III
subtitle: The Dungeon Master
blurb: The trilogy's quiet, strange finale: prove yourself worthy to the Dungeon Master.

title: Deadline
blurb: A wealthy man is dead in a locked library. You have twelve hours to find out who did it.

title: Starcross
blurb: A mining prospector intercepts an alien ship far larger than anything humans have built.

title: Suspended
subtitle: A Cryogenic Nightmare
blurb: Frozen in a cryogenic chamber, you keep a failing planet alive through six robots with very different senses.

title: The Witness
blurb: Los Angeles, 1938. A worried client asks for protection, and you arrive just in time to hear the shot.

title: Planetfall
blurb: A lowly Stellar Patrol ensign is stranded on a deserted planet with Floyd, the best robot sidekick ever written.

title: Enchanter
blurb: A novice enchanter is sent, armed with a spell book, against an evil warlock. The start of the Enchanter trilogy.

title: Infidel
blurb: Abandoned by your crew in the Egyptian desert, you go after a lost pyramid alone.

title: Sorcerer
blurb: Belboz, head of the Circle of Enchanters, has vanished. The second part of the Enchanter trilogy.

title: Seastalker
blurb: A young inventor takes a submarine to rescue an undersea research station from a sea monster.

title: Cutthroats
blurb: A diver on Hardscrabble Island falls in with a crew of treasure hunters who can't be trusted.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
blurb: Your house is about to be demolished, and then so is the Earth. Notoriously unfair, and very funny.

title: Suspect
blurb: A reporter at a costume ball is framed for murder and has one night to clear their name.

title: Wishbringer
blurb: A postal clerk delivers a letter and ends up in a darker Festeron. Written as an introduction to the genre.

title: A Mind Forever Voyaging
blurb: The first sentient computer explores simulations of its city's future to test a government's plan.

title: Spellbreaker
blurb: Magic itself is failing. The demanding finale of the Enchanter trilogy.

title: Ballyhoo
blurb: The circus owner's daughter has been kidnapped, and nobody under the big top is quite who they seem.

title: Trinity
blurb: A tourist in London's Kensington Gardens slips out of time and into the history of the atomic bomb.

title: Leather Goddesses of Phobos
blurb: A 1930s pulp romp across the solar system. Has a selectable naughtiness level.

title: Moonmist
blurb: A haunted Cornish castle, a ghost, and hidden treasure, with four different variations.

title: Hollywood Hijinx
blurb: Spend one night in your late uncle's Malibu mansion and find his ten treasures to inherit the estate.

title: Bureaucracy
blurb: You've moved house and your bank won't acknowledge your change of address. Watch your blood pressure.

title: Stationfall
blurb: Floyd returns for a paperwork run to a space station where something has gone very wrong.

title: The Lurking Horror
blurb: A snowbound night at G.U.E. Tech, a term paper due, and something old under the campus.

title: Plundered Hearts
blurb: A swashbuckling romance on the high seas, in search of your kidnapped father.

title: Nord and Bert Couldn't Make Head or Tail of It
blurb: Eight short stories built on puns, clichés and spoonerisms.

title: Beyond Zork
subtitle: The Coconut of Quendor
blurb: Zork with role-playing stats, a randomised map and an on-screen map window.
notes: Its map and stat windows don't show in this text-only player.

title: Border Zone
blurb: Three linked Cold War spy stories on a train and across a border, played against the clock.
notes: Its real-time pressure doesn't apply here; time only passes as you type.

title: Sherlock
subtitle: The Riddle of the Crown Jewels
blurb: As Watson, help Holmes recover the stolen Crown Jewels in 48 hours of Victorian London.

title: Zork Zero
subtitle: The Revenge of Megaboz
blurb: The prequel: lift a wizard's curse on the Flathead dynasty before the Empire falls.
notes: A graphical game; this player shows its text only.

title: Shōgun
blurb: James Clavell's novel, as a pilot shipwrecked in feudal Japan.
notes: A graphical game; this player shows its text only.

title: Journey
subtitle: The Quest Begins
blurb: Lead a party on a quest, choosing actions from menus instead of typing.
notes: A menu-driven graphical game; it may not be playable in this text-only player.

title: Arthur
subtitle: The Quest for Excalibur
blurb: Young Arthur has three days to prove himself and pull the sword from the stone.
notes: A graphical game; this player shows its text only.
